backend_identity_exception.ApplicationLaunch: Run attribute may be absent only on the exact first mapper-proven initial ApplicationLaunch ID in the fresh session. Any existing stale marker or extra view rejects. Do not overwrite metadata in a mapper.
backend_identity_exception.TTID: Only the exact fresh-session ApplicationLaunch-owned vital may lack the run attribute; any stale value rejects.

incidental_app_launch_vital.reason: FirstFrameReader installs independently of periodic vitals; native TTID has no public mapper. Inventory and startup barrier must include it instead of dropping an unexpected family.

incidental_app_launch_vital.owner: exact initial mapper-proven ApplicationLaunch view and fresh session
incidental_app_launch_vital.identity: Unique vital.id and configured application; initial absent run tag allowed only for exact startup owner; stale existing tag rejects.
incidental_app_launch_vital.startup_prerequisite: Fixture publishes initial ApplicationLaunch/session readiness and holds before Home. Host observes genuine TTID in whole-session backend query, then writes a nonce/run/build-bound one-use release control. Log actual control validation/consumption before Home. No delay-based owner guess.
incidental_app_launch_vital.limits: Incidental startup inventory only; no broader vital/performance qualification, TTFD or Flutter FBC expectation. No source/API/SDK change.

backend_representation.rum: Retain whole backend row including opaque id and attributes.custom; match opaque and semantic IDs independently.
backend_representation.apm_search: Preserve exact lexical decimal custom.duration and require integral nanoseconds equal local mapper duration; IDs are exact decimal strings/integers and full trace hex.
backend_representation.apm_detail: Preserve complete native spans plus actual metadata and whether is_truncated was present. No true truncation tag/message means complete per observed MCP convention. Select matching span without dropping unexpected detailed spans.
backend_representation.limits: get_trace exposes duration_ms and second-rounded start/end strings; do not invent raw nanosecond starts or absent sampling metrics. Local mapper/carrier sampling remains asserted.
backend_representation.raw_format_samples: Fresh historical synthetic queries confirm adapter representation only; no new runtime acceptance is inferred.

native_state_waits.rule: Install every state wait before its own operation, link each actual KVO observation once. No synthesized callback or unconsumed readiness.

contract.baseline_completed_resume_classification: Observe final Detail mapper state after the same bounded stop boundary in both arms. B requires inactive; A preserves actual state and every extra event/pending observation, then classifies any source-predicted phantom-active behavior only after runtime evidence. No invented baseline failure or filtering to candidate counts.

qualification_bound.meaning: At most one automatic and one registered unqualified native prerequisite launch before the four frozen accepted cells. Stop a failed lane, record failure, and diagnose before any source/oracle revision. Do not count a local prerequisite as backend acceptance.

timing_oracle.registered: Exact source conversion from observed genuine taskInterval; keep original interval endpoints. No synthetic callback injection.
timing_oracle.automatic: Positive event duration no greater than measured first-resume-through-mapper interval plus frozen1ms Date/integer precision allowance. This is a semantic bound, not performance acceptance.
timing_oracle.size: Source-derived positive decoded metric byte count, otherwise native countOfBytesReceived; body hash is separate.
